runs.text: The collection is computed once. Then every element is visited in order: from position 0 onwards for vectors and arrays, and in insertion order for dictionaries. An empty collection does not run the body.

blocks.title: Walking a vector

blocks.description: A vector with pan, leche and huevos at positions 0, 1 and 2. A frame moves through each cell and producto takes the value of the framed cell.

caption.text: The traversal moves through the cells in order. On every round,
holds a copy of the visited element.

runs.text: The traversal keeps the version of the collection when it starts and compares it before every step. If it does not match, the trap is raised.

points.text: visits every element in order, without indices.
With dictionaries two names are written: key and value.
The element name cannot be assigned.
Changing the structure of the collection during the traversal is a failure.
